title: Malaysian Beef Curry
description: A rich and flavorful curry made with tender beef and a blend of Southeast Asian spices.

ingredients.name: Beef (thinly sliced)
ingredients.notes: Sliced into thin strips for easy cooking

ingredients.name: Coconut oil
ingredients.notes: For sautéing the beef and onions

ingredients.name: Curry powder
ingredients.notes: A blend of spices for the curry

instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pan and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the pan and cook until the onion is translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the ginger paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the curry powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the simmered beef broth and bring to a simmer.
Return the beef to the pan and cook until the meat is tender, about 10-15 minutes.
Stir in the coconut milk and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the curry hot, garnished with chopped cilantro or scallions if desired.
